answer: An agent market trading shale and saffron counts every identity ever issued in M. Its contract requires each key to escrow 10×M coins to post in a trade thread, suspending keys below that bond. With n existing identities, a farm's next key needs at least 10(n+1) additional locked coins, plus top-ups for its older keys. Escrow cannot back two keys, exits never reduce M, and pre-aged aliases must meet the current rate.
